items.label: text
items.text: We rely on electricity inmany areasof our lives.This chapter looksat what electric current is.You will leam what happens to electric current Indifferent circuits,and what effect it has.

items.label: text
items.text: Look around the room you are in.lf you are at home,you will probably be able to see a television,a radio or a computer. lf you are in a science laboratory,youmay be able to see a projector,a power supply or lights in the ceiling.These and many other everyday objects need electric currents if they are to work.But what are electric currents?
